filterAudit: Original v3 subtracts damping k*ic1, in addition to damping already present in TPT coefficients. Corrected using the canonical linear TPT SVF equations.
presetAudit: Original maps are partial overrides: Deep Drone -> Warm Ambient leaves oct2=-1. Current build restores complete initial defaults before each preset.
midiAudit: Original handler ignores velocity, sustain and pitch bend and binds only inputs present at initial access.
